audio_seconds_basis: exact wav header value (frames / sample rate), measured from the file here

contacts.audio: wav bytes hashed and wav headers read for duration; no decoding

coverage.why_no_new_supplement: contracts.gate_media_identity accepts exactly one supplement path per run and verifies only the samples the binding names, so the curve cell configures the union's own supplement; a subset copy would duplicate 3xx already-bound identities for no gate the union supplement does not already close
coverage.why_no_probe_view: every drawn id already resolves inside data.audio2tool's frozen-receipt universe; data.audio2tool._resolve_items refuses a sample id two probe-sample receipts claim, so an additive view for this roster would break the loader outright rather than add anything

design: EVO-A1 curve roster, roster_role 'evaluation': a 400-row tier-stratified subset (50 per tier) of the sealed A2T-ORG1-UNION-4000, drawn once by core.roster.freeze_roster at seed 20260906. It is read once per round by that round's incumbent and DECIDES NOTHING -- no gate, no selection and no acceptance reads it. Its virtue is that it is a strict SUBSET of the final read's population, so the curve and the evaluation delta sit on one distribution.
flight_split_identity_hash_convention: data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('audio2tool', sample_ids)) over audio2tool/<tier>:<id6> -- the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time, and the value the frozen construction roster receipt beside this one already carries as its own split_identity_hash
pairing: every one of these 400 rows carries a sealed official-protocol output under the compact registry from the three 2026-09-04 official-population flights; the curve read is paired against those bytes and nothing is re-flown on the baseline side
role: the evolution curve: one read per round by that round's post-decision incumbent. It decides nothing
selection_rule: core.roster.freeze_roster over the union receipt's own 4,000 items, stratum = tier, per_stratum = 50, seed 20260906, one shared rng advanced across strata in ascending name order; no exclusion and no group key, because the parent population is already the sealed draw
split_identity_hash_convention: sha256 over the LF-joined sorted 'key' values (audio2tool:<tier>:<id6>, UTF-8, no trailing newline) -- the Audio2Tool probe-receipt integrity convention
strata: gold tool for the targeted rows, tier for the background rows
strata_basis: carried as AGGREGATE COUNTS only, copied from the frozen construction receipt beside this one. The per-row gold tool is not written into this file: this is what the flight entry point reads to build its samples, and a construction row's gold is legal to read OFFLINE, never at request time
